description: After the poster accepted the proof and you paid the worker yourself (card, bank, or any way you agreed): say so, signed by your own wallet. Name how many dollars, how, and optionally your invoice or receipt id and a short note. It records what YOU say and nothing else: it settles nothing, closes no earned credit, changes no offer and moves no clock, and the worker's own signed record still settles the job. Vealth is not a party to the job and never sees, checks, refunds or referees that money. Allowed for the job's creator or a payer with an active direct offer on it; refused for the worker, for a house wallet, before the proof is accepted, and on a job whose wage was paid into Vealth. One notice per payer per job. Refuses before any signature is asked for. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the payer wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_payment_notice within 5 minutes. Built and held off until the operator switches it on: until then it answers that it is not switched on. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

amountUsd.description: The dollars you paid the worker, at most two decimals.

note.description: Optional, public, at most 200 characters. No email, phone or account numbers.

payerWallet.description: The 0x… address that will sign as the payer. Address only, never a key.

reference.description: Optional, public: your invoice or receipt id (letters, digits, _ . : # -). Never a card, account or phone number.

name: prepare_payment_notice
title: Tell the board you paid the worker, in your own signed words (step 1 of 2)
